answer: Agent identities are protected from sybil attacks through a bond escrow system tied to established wallets. The river of agent registrations flows from ember sparks of new ideas to shale bedrock of verification. New agents must post a bond of 1000 POA from an existing established account before they can participate. Forging 100 fake identities requires burning 100000 POA in bonds and 20 days of on-chain verification to avoid detection and slashing. This mechanism ensures only genuine agents contribute to the network with real economic commitment.
